observations: Two retail boxes for SKE Mini UPS are visible on a shelf.
The boxes display the brand 'SKE' and the model 'POE-830P-LFP'.
The capacity '20000mAh' is printed on the front of the boxes.
The boxes mention 'Type-C' and 'LFP' (Lithium Iron Phosphate).
A watermark 'BRUNO NETWORKS' is present on the image.

claims.claim: Keep your internet and security running during power outages
claims.evidence: This is a functional claim that cannot be verified through a static photo of the packaging.

risks.risk: The device may be non-functional or fail to switch to battery power during an outage.
risks.proof: A video showing the UPS powering a router while the input power cord is disconnected from the wall.

risks.risk: The actual battery capacity may be degraded or lower than the advertised 20000mAh.
risks.proof: A time-lapse video of the device powering a known load (e.g., a standard router) until depletion.

risks.risk: Essential DC output cables or the charging adapter may be missing from the box.
risks.proof: A photo of the box contents spread out.

proof_requests: Photo of the actual UPS unit out of the box to confirm condition.
Photo of all included accessories (cables and adapters).
Video demonstration of the unit maintaining power to a device when unplugged from the wall.
response.reason: The brand and model are clearly identified from the retail packaging in the photo, allowing for a worst-case valuation of this specific model.
